definition: Mechanical intelligence refers to intelligence in machines or robots, such as the ability to carry out reasoning or emotion-related functions in ways that resemble human abilities. In this source, it is discussed in contrast with biological intelligence and as something that may be linked with biological systems to build more capable robot controllers.
